mapper.select: select p.po_id, p.po_no, p.cust_id, l.po_line_id, l.line_no, l.item_id, l.due_date, l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty as open_qty, l.recv_qty, l.unit_cd as line_unit, i.unit_cd as base_unit, case when l.unit_cd = i.unit_cd then 1 else uc.factor end as factor, case when va.ack_status in ('ACCEPTED', 'PARTIAL') then va.ack_id end as ack_id from srm_po p join srm_po_line l on l.po_id = p.po_id and l.line_status = 'OPEN' and l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty > 0 join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join mst_unit_conv uc on uc.item_id = l.item_id and uc.from_unit = l.unit_cd and uc.to_unit = i.unit_cd and uc.use_yn = 'Y' left join lateral (select a.ack_id, a.ack_status from srm_po_ack a where a.po_id = p.po_id and a.rev = p.rev order by a.ack_seq desc limit 1) va on true where p.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and p.status in ('ISSUED', 'ACKED', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and l.item_id in #{id} order by p.po_no, l.line_no

select y.po_line_id, y.eta_date, y.remain_qty from ( select al.po_line_id, a.eta_date, a.asn_id, al.line_no, al.qty - coalesce((select sum(x.qty) from srm_po_receipt x where x.asn_line_id = al.asn_line_id), 0) as remain_qty from srm_asn_line al join srm_asn a on a.asn_id = al.asn_id where a.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and al.po_line_id in #{id}) y where y.remain_qty > 0 order by y.po_line_id, y.eta_date, y.asn_id, y.line_no
